text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I have no excuse.
I couldn't even make it onto the board."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I make no excuses. It was purely a lack of ability on my part.
It seems I am still far too inexperienced...
choice_data_list: Nothing but tough opponents—gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Beside the master who places such high hopes in me,
this is no time for me to be standing still...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"I will surely achieve a great result in our next race
and repay my debt of gratitude to you, Trainer-dono!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pushing each other to greater heights against the strong
will help me grow even further.
Just thinking about it gets my blood pumping.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
I will return to my roots and devote myself once more!
